patch_description: This version restructures the signal logic into a small decision pipeline: context extraction, regime scoring, entry gating, and risk shaping. Instead of a single monolithic threshold block, it builds reusable feature buckets for microstructure, momentum, volatility, and macro pressure, then combines them into asymmetric long/short conviction scores. This improves maintainability by separating concerns, and can improve performance by letting the model prediction interact with richer regime-aware filters and volatility-adjusted sizing/exits without introducing lookahead.
